_README: PROPOSED .mcp.json -- HUMAN-CONFIRM before applying. Do NOT let an agent write this to the repo-root .mcp.json; the live Claude Code session reads .mcp.json directly. Review each server, install the referenced packages, then a human merges (or copies) this into ./.mcp.json. All servers are READ-ONLY over project data except the sqlite/memory result+log stores, which are scoped to derived artifacts only. No secrets are embedded; supply any tokens via env at apply time.

_notes.filesystem: Read-only access to data/ and vault/ so the model can browse corpora/intel WITHOUT write access. Uses the official @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem; the trailing path args are the ONLY roots it can see. Keep these RO -- never add src/, kernel/, or the repo root.
_notes.sqlite: Query DERIVED result tables only (predictions/calibration). Point --db at a results DB under data/ (e.g. data/results/predictions.sqlite). Never point it at a source-of-truth/corpus DB.
_notes.memory: A small signal/decision log (knowledge-graph memory) the assistant can append to across sessions. Stored under data/mcp_memory/ so it is gitignored with the rest of data/. This is the ONLY writable server.
_notes.sports_predictor: The read-only calibrated predictor skeleton in this repo. Shells the validated predict_matchup/recal_report CLIs; the LLM never authors a number. Requires `pip install mcp`.
